theme: Top-of-corpus sweep: grammar forms, truncated stems, and conversation-glue lemmas

한다.reason: Plain-style present declarative of 하다 (to do); a curated 'say' sense also exists (fw1706_hada_say). Not a standalone lemma; no row.

세요.reason: Grammar-only honorific request/imperative ending -(으)세요; teach in grammar surfaces, never as an elective vocabulary row.

다고.reason: Grammar-only quotative connective -다고; matches the owner's grammar-only precedent for 다는/으면/해서.

만들.reason: Tokenizer-truncated stem of curated 만들다 (ㄹ-drop forms such as 만들 + 어/고 split); no row from this fragment.

위해.reason: Grammar-only purpose construction ~을/를 위해 (위하다 inflection); belongs to grammar teaching, not an elective vocabulary row.

해야.reason: Grammar-only obligation form 하다 + -아야 (해야 하다/되다 pattern); matches the owner's grammar-only precedent for 해서.

가지.reason: Ambiguous between the bound counter 가지 (kind/sort), standalone nouns (branch; eggplant), and the truncated stem of 가지다 (to have); corpus dominance unclear from the queue alone.

대한.reason: Grammar-only attributive ~에 대한 (about/regarding, from 대하다); also appears as bound Sino morpheme in proper nouns (대한민국). No lexical row.

이런.reason: Standalone demonstrative determiner 'this kind of' (dictionary 관형사, lexicalized from 이렇다); high conversational value and not curated. Authoring, examples, and owner approval still required.

그렇.reason: Truncated stem of 그렇다 (to be so). The lemma itself is not curated and is a high-value future candidate (그렇지만/그렇군요 family), but this fragment never becomes a row.

된다.reason: Plain-style present of 되다 (to become / be okay). The lemma 되다 is NOT in the curated core — flagged as a high-value future candidate; this conjugated surface never becomes a row.

으며.reason: Grammar-only written connective -(으)며 (and/while); grammar surface, not a vocabulary row.

가장.reason: Superlative adverb 'most / the most' — a core dictionary lemma surprisingly absent from the curated bank; safe standalone lexical candidate for a conversation-glue elective pack.

바로.reason: Adverb 'right away / exactly / precisely' — standalone dictionary lemma, extremely frequent in speech, not curated; safe elective candidate.

모르.reason: Truncated stem of 모르다 (to not know). The lemma is NOT curated — flagged as a high-value future candidate (르-irregular); this fragment never becomes a row.

그런.reason: Standalone demonstrative determiner 'that kind of' (dictionary 관형사, lexicalized from 그렇다); pairs with 이런; not curated. Authoring and owner approval still required.

이렇.reason: Truncated stem of 이렇다 (to be like this), mostly from 이렇게 tokenization; lemma uncurated, fragment never a row.

그러.reason: Truncated stem of 그러다 (to do/say so), from forms like 그러면/그러니까/그러다가; lemma uncurated, fragment never a row.

보이.reason: Truncated stem of 보이다 (to be visible / seem). The lemma is NOT curated — flagged as a high-value future candidate; fragment never a row.

대해.reason: Grammar-only ~에 대해 (about/regarding, from 대하다); grammar surface, not a vocabulary row.

라도.reason: Particle -(이)라도 (even/at least); particles are excluded from vocabulary rows — grammar teaching belongs in grammar surfaces.

사이트.reason: Loanword noun 'site / website' — standalone lexical item, everyday tech register, not curated; safe elective candidate.

당신.reason: Pronoun 'you' — genuine dictionary lemma with restricted usage (between spouses, in formal writing/lyrics, or confrontational); authoring MUST carry an explicit usage caution note.

다면.reason: Grammar-only conditional -다면 (if, hypothetical); matches the owner's grammar-only precedent for 으면.

따라.reason: Conjugated form of 따르다 (to follow; to pour), dominated by the grammar pattern ~에 따라 (according to). Lemma uncurated and polysemous — preserve the lemma decision for authoring review; fragment never a row.

어떻.reason: Truncated stem of 어떻다 (to be how), overwhelmingly from 어떻게 tokenization; lemma uncurated, fragment never a row.

인데.reason: Grammar-only copula contrast/background form 이다 + -ㄴ데; grammar surface, not a vocabulary row.

위한.reason: Grammar-only attributive ~을/를 위한 (for the sake of, from 위하다); same family as 위해.

만나.reason: Stem/conjugated surface of curated 만나다 (to meet); no row from this form.

보내.reason: Stem/conjugated surface of 보내다. Two curated senses exist (w_m5_302_bonaeda 'to send', w_m6_3029_bonaeda_spend 'to spend time') — polysemous parent left null by explicit policy; no row from this form.

통해.reason: Grammar-only ~을/를 통해 (through/via, from 통하다); grammar surface, not a vocabulary row.

근데.reason: Colloquial contraction of 그런데 (but / by the way). 그런데 itself (rank 597) is an accepted lexical candidate in the next batch; teach 근데 as a spoken variant on that row, never as a separate row.
